# Flame v2.7.3

- Fix a rendering crash in Applications when an icon name is empty or contains leading, trailing or consecutive hyphens.
- Normalize application icon values before rendering and fall back to the existing `mdiCancel` icon when the name is missing or empty.
- Make the shared Material Design icon parser resilient to missing and malformed names, including those used by bookmarks.
- Add unit tests and Chromium regression coverage for unpinned applications with malformed icons, home-to-Applications navigation and editing.

Docker images are published for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
